title: Specified scalar presentations compute reduction after any chart pullback
statement: Fix $\ell,E,A,R_n$ and the quotient coordinates of [def-sfb-finite-model-quotient-coordinates]. Let $V,T$ be schemes, $f:T\to V$ any morphism, $M$ an integral coefficient module sheaf on $V$, $n\ge0$, and $e$ a normalized quotient encoding on $T$. Let $P$ be an $A$-module with an isomorphism $f^*M\simeq B_T\otimes_A P$. Let $a,b$ be finite ranks, $v$ an $A$-matrix, and $w:A^b\to P$ such that the actual integral differential $v:A^a\to A^b$ is injective, its image is the kernel of $w$, and $w$ is surjective. Then in the derived category over the quotient coefficient ring there is an isomorphism $f^*(M[0]\otimes^L_{B_V}R_{n,V})\simeq e^{-1}(\underline{[R_n^a\xrightarrow{\bar v}R_n^b]})$, using precisely the given quotient map and normalized encoding. No constructibility, qcqs or finite-presentation assumption on $P$ is needed beyond this exact presentation.

proof.text: Apply scalarPullComparison_isIso from FreeParameterScalarMaps to the actual reductionRing map. Compose its inverse with leftDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory and mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor to identify pullback of reduction with reduction of the pulled-back degree-zero module.

Use the chosen extension-integers DVR structure and constantToContinuous_preservesFiniteLimits to apply the proved modelFunctor_exact helper. The given function exactness, injectivity and surjectivity form a short exact sequence in ModuleCat, whose model image is short exact. Construct its augmentation from the double complex to the single cokernel and prove it a quasi-isomorphism, checking exactness in degree -1 and degree 0 and zero terms elsewhere.

Apply free_complex_reduction to the exact same scalar matrix. Map the specified chart model isomorphism and the inverse augmentation isomorphism through derived reduction, then compose with the pullback comparison and the free-complex reduction isomorphism.
